meta.name: CCNL Comparto Istruzione e Ricerca 2022-2024 e 2025-2027 (trattamento economico) - ARAN, AFAM (Alta formazione artistica, musicale e coreutica)

sources.title: CCNL 2025-2027 sui principali aspetti del trattamento economico, signed definitively on 1 July 2026 by ARAN and every union of the comparto. Tabella A2 (pp. 18-19): tabellare from 1.1.2025, 1.1.2026, 1.1.2027.

CCNL 2019-2021. Tabelle C1 and E1.5 (pp. 246, 256): tabellare from 1.2.2023.
CCNL Scuola 2006-2009, still in force for ferie (art. 13), malattia (art. 17) and tredicesima (art. 80).

source_document.title: CCNL Comparto Scuola 2006-2009, 29 novembre 2007

notes.text: SCOPE: staff of the AFAM institutions (accademie, conservatori, ISIA): Aree Operatori, Assistenti, Funzionari, Elevate Qualificazioni (new classification of art. 165 CCNL 18/1/2024 from 1.5.2024, allegato J), docenti di prima fascia and ricercatori, with seven bands of anzianità di servizio (Tabella D2 of the CCNL 2022-2024 and 2025-2027) as seniority steps, from 1.1.2024.

SHARED RULES: the hourly divisor, the tredicesima, the leave, absence, sickness and accrual rules are those of the scuola file of the same comparto (istruzione-ricerca-aran), not read again for the AFAM staff. No overtime table is modelled.

limitation.remediation: Read the AFAM sections of the CCNL 2019-2021 (18/1/2024) for leave, absence, sickness and overtime.

notes.text: PENSION FUND: the AFAM staff join the Fondo Espero, not modelled in this file.

limitation.remediation: Add the Fondo Espero rates of the AFAM staff.

notes.text: ALLOWANCES: RPD of the docenti (Tabella D3) and RPR of the ricercatori (D4) by band of anzianità di servizio (0-14, 15-27, 28 years and more), the CIA of operatori, assistenti and funzionari (D6), 12 instalments; the retribuzione di posizione parte fissa of the Elevate Qualificazioni (D5), annual over 12 (assumed). The banded allowances need the seniority of the worker.

provenance.note: No text of the comparto fixes the daily quota of an unpaid absence of the scuola staff: the only daily divisor in the texts read is the 1/30 of the compenso individuale accessorio (CCNL Scuola 2007, p. 75). by_26 is kept as extracted, not sourced. Searched on 2026-10-12: the trade press reports a deduction of 1/30 of the taxable monthly pay for a day of strike and 1/30 of the RPD or CIA for the first ten days of sickness (NoiPA practice), but no statute, CCNL or NoiPA document read gives the daily quota of an unpaid absence; it stays assumed until one is found.

provenance.transformation: 32 days (c. 2), 30 for the first 3 years of service (cc. 3-4: 'Dopo 3 anni di servizio, a qualsiasi titolo prestato'). The CCNL counts the three years in any public administration ('a qualsiasi titolo prestato' / 'presso una qualsiasi pubblica amministrazione'); the tiers read the seniority with this employer, so a worker with earlier public service gets 26 (30) days when the text gives 28 (32): state the seniority with the earlier public service included.
